title: oenothera brandegeei
intro: Oenothera brandegeei, commonly known as Brandegee's evening primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the evening primrose family. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin conditions and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera brandegeei include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting skin health.
